observation: Tracing with lifted text recreated this emblem at 97.1-97.6/100 against the pictures it was traced from, with every word live and audited. Fitting text to the reference copied the reference's flaws: the reference's 'Hashem for Israel' ran past the end of its bar, and poster_fit reproduced that faithfully. Setting the English words cleanly inside their bars took a script outside funkbox (find the straight run of the bar, shrink the text until it fits with a margin, centre it).
suggestion: Give text layers a 'fit_inside' option: a region of the artwork (a colour plus a point, or a traced shape) the words must stay inside with a margin, sized down to fit and centred along it; poster_fit could then respect it instead of chasing a flawed reference.
would_enable: A one-call recreate of any badge or logo with its words as live text, in about a minute instead of two.
